# teams_vdi_policy (Resource)

Manages the VdiPolicy policy via New-CsTeamsVdiPolicy / Get-CsTeamsVdiPolicy / Set-CsTeamsVdiPolicy / Remove-CsTeamsVdiPolicy.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identity` (String) Name (Identity) of the object; also the create key. Changing it forces replacement.

### Optional

- `disable_audio_video_in_calls_and_meetings` (Boolean) Maps to the -DisableAudioVideoInCallsAndMeetings parameter.
- `disable_calls_and_meetings` (Boolean) Maps to the -DisableCallsAndMeetings parameter.
- `vdi2_optimization` (String) Maps to the -VDI2Optimization parameter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
